title: Dissecting the NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU via Microbenchmarking
summary_zh: 以微基準逐指令、逐層快取剖析 Turing T4 推理 GPU。對我們最關鍵的發現：在 70 W 功耗上限下，當 cuBLAS GEMM 矩陣尺寸增大時，SM 核心時脈從固定的 1,590 MHz 下降到約 1,330 MHz（功耗上限節流，非純熱節流），最終壓低算術吞吐量；達 85 °C 後熱節流再加上一個更陡的階梯。這是我們「時脈隨輸入 token 數 M 上升而下降」論點最接近的古典微基準錨點。
summary_en: A microbenchmark dissection of the Turing T4 inference GPU, instruction by instruction and cache by cache. The finding most relevant to us: under the 70 W power cap, the SM core clock falls from a pinned 1,590 MHz toward about 1,330 MHz as cuBLAS GEMM matrix size grows (power-limit, not purely thermal, throttling), eventually depressing arithmetic throughput; once 85 °C is reached, thermal throttling adds a sharper step. This is the closest classical microbenchmark anchor for our claim that clock drops as input-token count M rises.
